title: conyza schiedeana
intro: Conyza schiedeana, commonly known as Mexican fleabane, is a plant species in the daisy family that is native to Mexico and Central America. It is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which help to reduce pain and swelling, and protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents present in Conyza schiedeana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antidiabetic properties. The plant's therapeutic actions make it a potential natural remedy for treating various health conditions, including wound healing, skin diseases, and diabetes.
